newsitem.title: UK: Deutsche pull-out from ring agreed by LME Board.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche pull-out from ring agreed by LME Board.

text.p: The London Metal Exchange (LME) approved the change in membership status of Deutsche Sharps Pixley away from Ring Dealing Member at Wednesday's LME Board meeting.
In a notice to members read out to the LME floor this afternoon, Exchange Chief Executive David King said that the Board approved the change with effect from 1330 local time today.
Earlier, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said its interests would be served by being an LME Associate Broker Clearing Member.
Deutsche Sharps Pixley, a unit of Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, was present on the ring this morning, but was not manning its LME floor booth this afternoon.

In approving the change in membership status, the LME board noted that Deutsche Sharps Pixley had decided to re-focus its LME operations but remain fully committed to the base metals business, King said.
